name: Vigilante Mentalist
body:
Your command over the mystical powers of the mind gives you added tools in your arsenal, allowing you to create astonishing psychic effects that supplement your mundane vigilante abilities.

Class Skills

You gain a number of skill ranks per level equal to 4 + your Intelligence modifier.

Knowledge (arcana) and Spellcraft are class skills for you, but Device Disable, Knowledge (engineering), Sleight of Hand, and Survival are not.

This feature alters class skills and skill ranks.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

You are not proficient with medium armor.

This feature alters weapon and armor proficiency.

Spellcasting

You cast psychic spells and knacks as a mesmerist. You choose your spells from the 6th-level and lower spells from the psychic spell list; higher-level psychic spells are not on the mentalist’s spell list.

This feature replaces the 4th-, 8th-, 10th-, 14th-, and 16th-level vigilante talents.

Psychic Bolt (Su)

By concentrating the powers of your mind, you can project bolts of mental energy at your foes. A psychic bolt is a ranged touch attack with a range of 30 feet, and deals 1d6 points of force damage plus your Charisma modifier, plus 1d6 additional points of force damage for every 3 vigilante levels you possess. This is a mind-affecting effect.

Attacking with a psychic bolt takes the place of one of your normal attacks, and you can make a full attack using psychic bolts. You can apply feats and abilities that apply to ranged weapon attacks. Weapon Focus (ray) doesn’t apply to psychic bolts, but you can take Weapon Focus (psychic bolt).

This feature replaces vigilante specialization.

Mentalist Talents

You can select from any of the following vigilante talents, in addition to general vigilante talents.

This feature alters vigilante talents.

Emotional Legacy (Su)

The echoes of the deeds of heroes past resonate through you.

Choose one emotional focus available to a spiritualist’s phantom. You gain the Skill Focus feat for both of the skills associated with that emotional focus. In addition, you gain a +1 bonus against mind-affecting effects for every 4 vigilante levels you possess.

Psychic Blast (Su)

As a standard action, you can choose to have your psychic bolt affect all targets in a 30-foot cone instead of a single target in range. A Will save halves the damage (DC 10 + 1/2 your vigilante level + your Charisma modifier). You must be at least 8th level to select this talent.

Character Options: The Vigilante. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum.
